rows.note: Use 完美 as the all-purpose adjective for something flawless, excellent, or ideal.

example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa6 zan1 hai6 jyun4 mei5

rows.note: Use this when something fits a definition or requirement exactly, rather than merely being excellent.

example.english: This answer is a perfect match for the definition.
example.traditional: 呢個答案同個定義啱晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 tung4 go3 ding6 ji6 ngaam1 saai3

rows.note: Use this when something is especially suitable for a particular purpose or use.

example.english: This knife is perfect for opening boxes.
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 dou1 lo2 lai4 hoi1 soeng1 ngaam1 jung6

rows.note: Use this in the technical musical names of perfect intervals, such as 純五度.

example.english: This interval is a perfect fifth.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jam1 cing4 hai6 seon4 ng5 dou6
